name: SHINE-Mapping Loss Function
definition: A loss function for SDF-based mapping that uses projected signed distance along the ray as supervision, mapped to [0,1] via sigmoid, and optimized with Binary Cross Entropy (BCE), Eikonal regularization, and a forgetting-prevention regularization term.
summary: The SHINE-Mapping Loss Function trains neural SDFs using direct range sensor data, combining Binary Cross Entropy, Eikonal regularization, and a forgetting prevention term to ensure accurate incremental mapping.
